title: Tensor-Hom adjunction for modules over a commutative ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M,N,P$ $R$-modules, with $M\otimes_RN$ their tensor product. For every $R$-linear map $f:M\to\operatorname{Hom}_R(N,P)$ there is a unique $R$-linear map $\hat f:M\otimes_RN\to P$ with $\hat f(x\otimes y)=f(x)(y)$ for all $x\in M$, $y\in N$, and $f\mapsto\hat f$ is an isomorphism of $R$-modules $\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,\operatorname{Hom}_R(N,P))\to\operatorname{Hom}_R(M\otimes_RN,P)$, with inverse $g\mapsto(x\mapsto(y\mapsto g(x\otimes y)))$. In particular two $R$-linear maps $M\otimes_RN\to P$ that agree on all $x\otimes y$ are equal.
